summary: 1982 Bell helicopter leased to SAM Surveying, doing pipeline survey work in Otero County, suffered a reported tail-rotor problem and spun into the ground ~3 miles south of County Road AA and County Road 33 south of La Junta; heavily damaged. Otero County SO received the 911 call ~12:00 pm; rescue workers removed three slightly injured occupants to ambulances, transported to Arkansas Valley Regional Medical Center in La Junta.
location: South of La Junta, ~3 mi south of County Road AA and County Road 33 (private property)
responding_agency: Otero County Sheriff's Office; La Junta Rural Fire Department; Colorado State Patrol
notes: RESOLVES the parked Otero 2013-05-07 helicopter-crash lead (Prowers Journal archive page failed to open tool-side at runs 778/797/837 — parent-opened run 858). Date weekday-verified: Tuesday 2013-05-07 MDT. Incident-type per the id-2620 single-engine-crash precedent (injury/injury).
